# g1t

> A minimal CLI for recording your commits.

## Overview

g1t is a single-file Node.js CLI by nirholas, published to npm as `g1t`. It has no
dependencies and no build step: the whole program is `index.js`, exposed as the `g1t`
bin. The current release (0.0.1) is a stub that prints a banner and reserves the
command name.
